outcome: transition time to full enteral feeding (FEF)
cohort: The study included 61 neonates diagnosed with hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) and treated by therapeutic hypothermia.
finding: Transition time to full enteral feeding (FEF) was negatively correlated with gestational week and birth weight, and positively correlated with lactate, BUN, and creatinine levels, duration of invasive and non-invasive mechanical ventilation, and use of antibiotics and inotropic agents.
